common.open: Show the guide for this page
common.help: Press this question mark any time to replay the guide for the page you are on.

dashboard.welcome: This short guide shows you around. Use Next to continue, or close it any time.
dashboard.setup: Do these steps in order. Each “Show me” opens the right page with its own guide. Ticks appear by themselves as you finish.
dashboard.menu: Everything is grouped here: sales (orders, deliveries, money), customers, catalog, your team, and billing & help.
dashboard.kpis: Sales, orders, collections and dues for the period you pick above. Hover a card to see the trend.
dashboard.bell: Orders to approve, deposits to confirm and low stock show up here. When everything is done, it stays empty.

orders.title: Orders
orders.intro: Orders from your sales reps arrive here, straight from the app.
orders.actions: Approve or reject selected orders, and print invoices.
orders.extra: Tabs sort orders by step: waiting, approved, on the way, delivered. Start with “Pending”.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.intro: Group approved orders into trips for your delivery men.
deliveries.actions: Create a trip: pick a delivery man and the orders to load.

collections.title: Collections
collections.intro: Money collected in the field — cash, bKash, Nagad, bank.
collections.actions: Confirm payments and the cash your staff hand in.
collections.extra: Check digital payments first; then count cash deposits from delivery men.

returns.title: Returns
returns.intro: Goods shops send back. Approve them to put good stock back and reduce the shop’s dues.

shops.title: Shops
shops.intro: Your customers. Sales reps can add new shops from the app; you approve them here.
shops.actions: Add shops, import a list, or move shops to another route.
shops.extra: Shops added from the field wait under “Pending approval”.

areas.title: Areas & routes
areas.intro: Your territory: zone → area → route. Each route has visit days, a sales rep and a delivery man.
areas.actions: Start with “Add area” — you can create the zone at the same time. Then add routes to it.
areas.extra: Click a route to see its shops and who covers it. The + next to an area adds a route there.

products.title: Products
products.intro: Everything you sell, with pack size and price.
products.actions: Add a product: name, SKU, pack size (pieces per carton), MRP and your price.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: Different prices for different shops — wholesale, pharmacy or an area.
pricing.actions: Create a price list, then change prices one by one or by percent.

stock.title: Stock
stock.intro: How much is in each store, and what is reserved for approved orders.
stock.actions: Enter purchases with “Adjust”, and move goods between stores with “Transfer”.
stock.extra: Switch between the main godown, vans and the damage store.

staff.title: Staff
staff.intro: Everyone who uses Onukrom: office people and field staff.
staff.actions: Invite a sales rep or delivery man with their phone number. Their password appears once — they log in to the app with company code + phone + password.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.intro: What each role is allowed to do.
roles.actions: Make a new role from an existing one, then tick what it may do.

settings.title: Company settings
settings.intro: Your company details and the rules for orders and GPS.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Charts of sales, dues and collections, and every report as PDF or CSV.
reports.actions: Pick a period, or download the whole page as a PDF to share.

billing.title: Billing
billing.actions: Pay an invoice by bKash/Nagad/bank and submit the transaction ID.
billing.extra: Need more staff? Switch to a bigger plan here.

support.title: Help & support
support.intro: Ask the Onukrom team anything; answers come here.
